Method of Attack: Phishing Facebook user credentials via a fake login screen
Hides app icon and runs background service
Starts a transparent WebView to log into victim's Facebook account using stolen credentials
Harvests detailed Facebook account information including education, work, contacts, bio, family, relationships, events, groups, likes, posts, pages
Uses Facebook search functionality and dynamic web techniques (scrolling, Ajax calls) to collect data
Attack Vector: Distributed inside malicious apps on third-party app stores targeting English-speaking users
Indicators of Compromise: Transparent WebView with alpha-transparency 0.01f loading Facebook login page
